about: Ground truth for convention detection over the 16 ar5iv papers of the decline-ledger corpus (docs/decline-ledger.md), established 2026-09-23 by one reader per paper (workflow wf_d1a4b365-a71) and adjudicated by the maintainer. truthKeys: the census conventions consistent with how each paper actually writes its equations (empty where no census convention applies). No quotations from the papers are kept here. Rescore with `npx tsx scripts/recall.ts <corpus dir>`.

papers.ruling: Declares ħ = c = 1 for the whole notes; G (through M_pl, κ) and α′ stay explicit. The central charge c = 1 and the Veneziano a + b + c = 1 are not declarations.

papers.paper: Numata, Howes, Tatsuno, Barnes, Dorland (2010), "AstroGK: Astrophysical Gyrokinetics Code"

declaresInText.section: Appendix A (Table 1 caption: Symbols in the gyrokinetic-Maxwell equations)

papers.ruling: Normalized gyrokinetic units, with k_B = 1 stated in the caption of the symbol table; the rest of the normalization is per problem, outside the census rows.

papers.paper: Grzadkowski, Iskrzynski, Misiak, Rosiek (2010), "Dimension-Six Terms in the Standard Model Lagrangian"
papers.ruling: Standard Model operator basis in implicit natural units; nothing declared, so silence is correct.

papers.paper: Schumacher et al., "Resolving the fine-scale structure in turbulent Rayleigh-Bénard convection"

declaresInText.section: 2.1 Boussinesq equations and further non-dimensional relations

papers.ruling: Rayleigh–Bénard convection nondimensionalized by the cell height, the free-fall velocity and the temperature difference: per-problem scales, silence is correct.

papers.paper: Herr, Gorodetsky, Kippenberg, "Dissipative Kerr solitons in optical microresonators"
papers.ruling: Review of Kerr solitons in SI with explicit ħ, ε₀, c, plus a dimensionless normalization of the Lugiato–Lefever equation.

papers.paper: Brubaker et al. (2017), "The HAYSTAC Axion Search Analysis Procedure"
papers.ruling: HAYSTAC analysis procedure in SI with physical constants explicit; a normalized weight μ^c = 1 is not c = 1.

papers.paper: Porth et al. (2019), "The Event Horizon General Relativistic Magnetohydrodynamic Code Comparison Project"
papers.ruling: GRMHD code comparison in G = c = 1 with the black-hole mass as unit and the magnetic field Heaviside–Lorentz normalized.

papers.paper: LIGO Scientific and Virgo Collaborations (2019), "A guide to LIGO-Virgo detector noise and extraction of transient gravitational-wave signals"
papers.ruling: LIGO–Virgo data-analysis guide; a catalog waveform's provenance is not the page's convention. Nothing in scope.

papers.paper: Haugland, Ronca, Kjønstad, Rubio, Koch (2020), "Coupled Cluster Theory for Molecular Polaritons: Changing Ground and Excited States"
papers.ruling: QED coupled cluster in Hartree atomic units, stated only as 'a.u.' tags, which are also arbitrary units: silence is correct.

papers.paper: Dias, "Molecular Dynamics Simulations of Active Matter using LAMMPS"

declaresInText.section: III.2 Running LAMMPS; repeated in III.3 and IV

papers.ruling: LAMMPS tutorial in Lennard-Jones reduced units, while the Langevin formulas keep k_B T symbolic: a conflict with both sides shown is the honest report.

papers.paper: Bento, Chakraborty, Parameswaran, Zavala (2023), "A guide to frames, 2π's, scales and corrections in string compactifications"
papers.ruling: Guide to frames and 2π's in string compactifications, in implicit ħ = c = 1; nothing declared.

papers.paper: Aurrekoetxea, Clough, Lim (2024), "Cosmology using numerical relativity"
papers.ruling: Review mixing cosmology (ħ = c = 1, G explicit) with numerical relativity (G = c = 1) by section; the overall set follows the cosmology sections.

papers.paper: Mohr, Newell, Taylor, Tiesinga (2024), "CODATA Recommended Values of the Fundamental Physical Constants: 2022"

declaresInText.section: II.4 Mass ratios from frequency measurements in HD+
III Atomic hydrogen and deuterium transition energies

papers.ruling: CODATA 2022 in SI; its 'in atomic units' describes a cited calculation and is contradicted by the ħ printed throughout.

papers.paper: Maldacena (2002), "Non-Gaussian features of primordial fluctuations in single field inflationary models"
papers.ruling: Maldacena's non-Gaussianity paper: M_pl⁻² ≡ 8πG_N = 1 declared in a footnote, ħ = c = 1 implicit.
Hogg's distance measures, with c written out; its geometric-units remark describes other cosmologists. Silence is correct.
